name: ConGregate
blurb: An all-volunteer, interactive science-fiction convention held each July in the Triad region of North Carolina.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'When & Where July 9-11, 2027 Greensboro Marriott Airport' and 'Guests of Honor Michael A. Stackpole Timothy Zahn ... 2027 Featured Guests include: Michael A. Stackpole and Timothy Zahn'

notes: There is no separate guest-listing page (the nav's 'Guests' item and a direct /guests URL 404; the only guest content is the 'Guests of Honor' section on the homepage itself), so the homepage was re-extracted in --mode guests to get numbered candidates. Skipped #3 'Greg 8' (the con's mascot/alien character, not a real person) and #5 'Outworld Fleet Radio' (listed under the Sponsors section, not Guests of Honor). The two Guest of Honor cards (#1, #2) carry only a photo and name, no credit text, so 'Known for' is left blank for both per RESEARCH.md; cat 'author' is used because Stackpole and Zahn are known science-fiction novelists, which the homepage text itself corroborates in context (Star Wars-themed con, 'Celebrating 50 years of Star Wars'). Guest-freshness recheck (verify-06, 2026-10-05): confirmed current — the homepage's Guests of Honor section still shows only the Stackpole/Zahn cards tied to the same July 9-11, 2027 date block, with no separate or older guest listing anywhere on the site. Refute-03 recheck (2026-10-05): tried to refute, upheld -- unchanged on a fresh fetch, and a web search found ConGregate 2026's actual featured guests were Richard Kadrey, John Scalzi and Sherrilyn Kenyon, entirely different people; since this con has only one undated homepage (no archive), that mismatch is the strongest available evidence that the current Stackpole/Zahn grid is not a leftover from the recently-ended prior edition, and it sits beside the '50 years of Star Wars' anniversary theme that can only apply to 2027.
